test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’

Based on the above, how is G related to K if ‘G + J ÷ H × I − K’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 +
 
 
–

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 Mother
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 

Given: G + J ÷ H × I − K 

G + J → G is the mother of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bb8c2398a403259bc6e0a8b5e7d4b5e5fab2438e1921856e4a4db885bd60bbb.png] 

J ÷ H → J is the father of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aac693616989b1b1eb329fb8f5788d40d2345111859ba55c6dea76df881c1fa0.png] 

H × I → H is the wife of I.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b1321517790f2f4eff234285724977a094567b01d95407b62ec567f8702fbe7.png] 

I − K → I is the brother of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e429a88f070a9d8ac4226eaaf9d0a64a1e4630f9b5891fd42307f8d3eb6844a1.png] 

Here, G is the brother’s wife’s father’s mother of K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
